entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help. I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I was hoping to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. To be honest, I just... I **changed my mind**. It was a bit of an **impulse buy**, and I've found I just **don't use it** like I thought I would.
I see. Let me just pull up your account information. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF-651-98B.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 25 days ago, on January 2nd.

Yes, that's right. I know it's been a few weeks. I feel so bad about it, but I really needed this money back for a bill. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I was really hoping you could make an exception.
I understand completely. Let me just check our current return policy for you... Okay, I've just reviewed our internal guidelines.
And good news! According to our knowledge base, all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 25, you are unfortunately outside that window.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much!

It's no problem at all, Sarah. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That is such a relief. You've been a huge help, Diana. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
